mapper.select: SELECT '수입' as iType, InAmt.날짜 as ADate, CoutConf2.항 As Nm1, CoutConf3.목 As Nm2, Case when InAmt.비고 is not null and InAmt.이름2 is not null then InAmt.이름1 || ' '|| InAmt.이름2 || ' [' || InAmt.비고||']' when InAmt.비고 is not null then InAmt.이름1 || ' [' || InAmt.비고||']' when InAmt.이름2 is not null then InAmt.이름1 || ' '|| InAmt.이름2 else InAmt.이름1 end as Nm3, InAmt.금액 as Amt, InAmt.계정코드1 as Code1, InAmt.계정코드2 as Code2, InAmt.계정코드3 as Code3, 0 as Seq1, CoutConf2.순서 as Seq2, CoutConf3.순서 as Seq3 FROM 수입 InAmt, 수입항 CoutConf2, 수입목 CoutConf3 WHERE InAmt.계정코드2 = CoutConf2.항코드 AND InAmt.코드분류 = CoutConf2.코드분류 AND InAmt.계정코드2 = CoutConf3.항코드 AND InAmt.계정코드3 = CoutConf3.목코드 AND InAmt.코드분류 = CoutConf3.코드분류 AND InAmt.년도 = #{year} AND InAmt.날짜 = #{date} And InAmt.코드분류 = #{codeGb} union all SELECT '지출' as iType, OutAmt.날짜 as ADate, CoutConf1.관 As Nm1, CoutConf2.항 As Nm2, case when OutAmt.비고 is not null then CoutConf3.목 || ' ['|| OutAmt.비고||']' else CoutConf3.목 end as Nm3, OutAmt.금액 as Amt, OutAmt.계정코드1 as Code1, OutAmt.계정코드2 as Code2, OutAmt.계정코드3 as Code3, CoutConf1.순서 as Seq1, CoutConf2.순서 as Seq2, CoutConf3.순서 as Seq3 FROM 지출 OutAmt, 지출관 CoutConf1, 지출항 CoutConf2, 지출목 CoutConf3 Where OutAmt.계정코드1 = CoutConf1.관코드 AND OutAmt.코드분류 = CoutConf1.코드분류 AND OutAmt.계정코드1 = CoutConf2.관코드 AND OutAmt.계정코드2 = CoutConf2.항코드 AND OutAmt.코드분류 = CoutConf2.코드분류 AND OutAmt.계정코드1 = CoutConf3.관코드 AND OutAmt.계정코드2 = CoutConf3.항코드 AND OutAmt.계정코드3 = CoutConf3.목코드 AND OutAmt.코드분류 = CoutConf3.코드분류 and OutAmt.년도 = #{year} AND OutAmt.날짜 = #{date} And OutAmt.코드분류 = #{codeGb} order by 1,2,10,11,12,7,8,9,5
